brief: A podcast player where episodes are constellations — listened ones glow, series form patterns

dominant_strengths: Strong conceptual metaphor — constellations as series with glowing 'listened' nodes is genuinely poetic and memorable
Restrained dark palette with mint accents creates an immersive cosmic mood that suits late-night listening
Legend system (Unlistened/Listened/Now Playing) shows thoughtful state encoding through luminosity
dominant_weaknesses: Legend in top-right collides with 'Science Deep Dive' label — basic layout collision breaks the craft illusion
Constellation labels float without clear hierarchy; tiny dots are hard to target, hurting behavioral usability
Vast empty middle wastes spatial real estate while clusters feel arbitrarily placed rather than truly pattern-forming
fix_priorities: Resolve label/legend overlap and establish clear z-order between constellations, labels, and UI chrome
Add affordances on hover (episode title, progress arc) so dots reveal information instead of feeling decorative
Tighten constellation shapes so each series reads as a recognizable figure, not random scatter
Increase touch targets and add connecting line weights that encode listening progress through the series
rationale.norman_balance: Strong reflective concept and decent visceral atmosphere, but behavioral usability is weak — tiny dots and unclear interactions undermine navigation.
rationale.intent_fit: Conceptually nails the brief — listened episodes glow, series form patterns — but execution lacks the interaction depth and compositional polish to fully deliver the metaphor.
